parsed.name: SQR1三球六自由度运动平台
parsed.description: 一套通过EPICS控制的三球六自由度运动平台，可对X、Y、Z三个平移轴以及rX、rY、rZ三个转动轴进行单轴或联动控制。适用于实验中样品、光学元件或工装的精密定位与姿态调整。
parsed.description_en: An EPICS-controlled tri-sphere six-axis motion stage that supports individual or coordinated control of X, Y, Z translations and rX, rY, rZ rotations. It is used in laboratories for precise positioning and angular alignment of samples, optics, or fixtures.

actions.description: 同时移动一个或多个轴到指定位置，或移动到预设位置。
actions.description_en: Move one or more axes simultaneously to specified positions or to a preset position.

actions.description: 返回可用的预设位置列表。
actions.description_en: Return the list of available preset positions.

actions.description: 将各轴设定值与当前位置读回同步，用于启动初始化或避免未初始化轴误动作。
actions.description_en: Synchronize each axis setpoint with its current readback, typically for startup initialization or to avoid unintended motion of uninitialized axes.

actions.description: 移动单个轴到目标位置。
actions.description_en: Move a single axis to a target position.

actions.description: 设置单个轴的目标位置并执行定位。
actions.description_en: Set a single axis target position and perform the positioning move.
